Market today: Treasury yields easing off highs and Fed minutes showing no rate hike appetite are positives, but consumer pessimism is a drag. Tech/chip names are sensitive to this macro backdrop.

Your holdings: SOXL (-29.29%) and SPAL (-17.02%) are still in the SELL zone, needing attention. These leveraged ETFs amplify drawdowns, especially on margin.

Watch: The Microsoft/Nvidia AI laptop partnership is a direct play on your sector.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for catalysts in AI hardware.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its current loss.
No new buys today - hold and watch
